Klasse DirectoryEntry

java.lang.Object
filesystem.DirectoryEntry
public class DirectoryEntry extends Object
DirectoryEntry represents a single file or directory entry in a FAT32 filesystem.

Each entry contains metadata about a file or directory including its name, starting cluster number, file size, and status flags indicating whether it is deleted or a directory.

Deleted entries are marked with isDeleted = true (first byte of entry = 0xE5).
Directory entries are marked with isDirectory = true (attribute bit 0x10).

Version:
1.0
Autor:
Bastian Rentzsch

  • Konstruktordetails

    • DirectoryEntry

      public DirectoryEntry(String fileName, long startCluster, long fileSize, boolean isDeleted, boolean isDirectory, int level)
      Constructs a DirectoryEntry with all metadata fields.
      Parameter:
      fileName - the name of the file or directory
      startCluster - the starting cluster number (≥ 2 for valid entries)
      fileSize - the file size in bytes (0 for directories)
      isDeleted - true if entry is marked deleted
      isDirectory - true if entry is a directory
      level - the directory depth level for indentation

  • Methodendetails

    • toString

      public String toString()
      Returns a formatted string representation of the directory entry.

      The format includes:
      - Indentation based on directory level
      - [DELETED] marker in red/yellow if isDeleted is true
      - File or directory name
      - Starting cluster number
      - File size in bytes

      Setzt außer Kraft:
      toString in Klasse Object
      Gibt zurück:
      formatted string like " [DELETED] filename | Cluster: 5 | Size: 2048"
